to: Odin hiring team via the application channel in the HN post
subject: Application — Lead Platform Engineer & Lead Software Engineer — evidence-first delivery
body:
Dear Odin hiring team,

I am applying for the Lead Platform Engineer & Lead Software Engineer role you posted in the latest public HN Who's Hiring thread. I focused this note on the requirements visible in that post rather than sending a generic AI cover letter.

Evidence aligned to the spec:
- TypeScript: 21 live, no-login HTML5 games demonstrate shipped browser delivery and short feedback loops.
- React: 21 live, no-login HTML5 games demonstrate shipped browser delivery and short feedback loops.
- Node.js: 21 live, no-login HTML5 games demonstrate shipped browser delivery and short feedback loops.
- GCP: This requirement needs operator confirmation before submission; the draft does not invent unsupported experience.

The most legible portfolio entry is https://hfo-games.pages.dev/: 21 live browser games that can be opened without an account. The four Suika DLC variants show controlled reuse; the Gen-133 repository at https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133 shows held-out verification, append-only state, and explicit refusal to count a staged artifact as an external result.

For a first conversation, I would be most useful on a bounded delivery problem where the acceptance test is known and production claims must be backed by a runnable receipt. I have intentionally not claimed years, degrees, work authorization, or location eligibility that are not established by the public portfolio; those should be confirmed in the application form before submission.

Thank you for considering the application.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming
